name: Pagefind Static Site Search
free_limit: MIT-licensed fully static full-text search indexer and browser-side search UI for built HTML websites; no vendor-imposed query, site, or document quota and no hosted search server required.
watch_out: You must run indexing during your site build and host the generated static search bundle yourself. Hosting/CDN bandwidth and CI build resources may cost money; large indexes increase build and client download costs. This is software, not a managed hosted search plan.
